problem_restatement: V57 deliberately excludes the unvalidated SPCX long side while retaining the short cash-open gap-reversal route. The retained short now needs exact prospective execution and prior-close exit evidence rather than inheritance from the rejected long side or earlier profiles.

prospective_boundary.selection_rule: Subtract the frozen cumulative readiness baseline and accept only exact attributed decisions at or after capture_start_ms.

minimum_diagnostic_evidence.short: At least one post-boundary attributable eligible SPCX short decision and fully resolved short lifecycle.
required_fields: cash-open signal identity and decision timestamp
prior-close target and provider-recipe exit attribution
fees, funding, slippage, excursion, giveback, and net PnL

validation_completed.identity_reconciliation: provider, signal strategy, HIP-3 symbol, short-only execution override, run, profile, and fingerprint match the active checkpoint
validation_completed.baseline_reconciliation: 24 evaluations, zero eligible, zero open, and zero closed current-run lifecycles

failure_modes_and_falsifiers: Any frozen identity or short-only execution override changes.
Readiness totals regress behind the baseline or a pre-boundary decision is admitted.
Generator or preregistration evidence changes before publication.
An eligible decision remains unattributed or a lifecycle lacks prior-close exit evidence or exact costs.
The watcher gains execution authority or treats one short lifecycle as proof of profitability.
decision: Collect the first exact retained SPCX short lifecycle without restoring long authority or changing the live route.

confidence.route_edge: low pending exact V57 short execution evidence
